lines.text: A quiet man in a dark suit boards a flight to Seattle.
The name on his ticket is Dan Cooper.
Mid-flight, he hands the flight attendant a note.
He wants two hundred thousand dollars, and four parachutes.
In Seattle, he lets every passenger go.
Then, somewhere over the dark forests of Washington, in the rain,
he opens the rear stairs, and jumps.
Nine years later, a boy found some of the cash buried by a river.
The rest of it, and Dan Cooper, are still missing.
